title: ISS LIS lightning · flat texture
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio

geo.validation: Empirical full-image world alignment, not embedded georeferencing; see docs/additional-datasets.json.

missingBehavior: Masked annotation pixels and unmatched feature colors are unavailable. Valid zero brightness remains distinct from missing data.
description: Quality-controlled ISS Lightning Imaging Sensor visualization, March 2017–July 2023, with a ten-day roving window. Yellow-mark brightness and neighborhood coverage are visual features, not event counts or flash rate.
provenanceNote: Extracted from the official 4096 × 2048 Science On a Sphere equirectangular texture movie, not the rotating globe preview; downsampled to 2048 × 1024.
representedInterval: Source collection March 2017–July 2023, displayed with a ten-day moving window. Exact scientific end date of each extracted animation frame is unverified.
limitations: An unmarked region is only low visual mark coverage, not proof of zero flashes or satellite coverage. No per-frame dates are fabricated: the page’s labels.txt ends with an inconsistent 2003 date, and its mapping to this movie is unverified. Animation frame numbers establish ordering only. Grey guides and terrain are excluded by yellow-hue matching; marks are composited visual symbols and cannot recover lightning counts.
